utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits so far—do you know the repair list or start time yet? I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — it’s on, and we’re starting at 10 this morning. The main list is sorting donated supplies, moving furniture, and checking the flagged repairs, so if you can pass that along, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, I’ve got it: 10 this morning, with sorting donated supplies, moving furniture, and checking the flagged repairs. I’ll pass that along right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Rosa—that’d help a lot. I’ll let folks know the sorting table is still the main spot to start, and I’ll keep passing along any new needs as they come up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ll pass that along and ask a couple more neighbors to come early for sorting and loading. That should help keep things moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll sort the supplies and put together a short outreach list. If I spot any gaps, I’ll flag them right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Cleo — that helps a lot. If you can also keep me posted on any gaps, I’ll handle the rest as quietly as I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact repair list and a firm start time before I can commit. Once those are set, I can plan for the right drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send it over as soon as I get the exact repair list and start time. Once those are firm, I can commit and plan the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Kira
